name: Pact
summary: Consumer-driven contract testing: consumers record their expectations as pacts, and providers verify them in their own CI.
strengths: Catches breaking API changes without a shared end-to-end environment.
A broker shows which versions are safe to deploy together.
tradeoffs: Needs buy-in from both consumer and provider teams.
A poor fit for public APIs where you do not know the consumers.
Contracts do not prove that a full user journey works.
